result.units: net match points per Night; 10 points per initial hand exposure
result.protocol: paired deterministic counterfactual scenarios; same four initial cards, dealer up/hole, and hand/dealer lanes for every profile; Cofre has its own lane; not a physical shoe or multiplayer mirror

policies.conserve: EV-optimal composition and P1B action choices; never reads or maneuvers; baseline resource control
policies.eager: EV-optimal composition; reads whenever affordable and maneuvers whenever a public total-distance heuristic strictly improves; uses a transparent hole-aware basic heuristic only after Read
policies.horizon: EV-optimal composition; delays Read to the final round, and maneuvers only in the final round when public total-distance improves; approximate horizon rule, not a dynamic-programming oracle

bm.label: B-M: Cofre + Focus + Manobra, no Read

limitations: No exact finite-horizon EV/regret solver for shared Focus has been implemented; comparisons use fixed deterministic resource policies and report paired score differences against DF-SYM, not regret against an oracle.
Post-Read action selection uses a simple explicit hole-aware heuristic, not a conditional EV solver; all other hand actions use the existing P1B solver.

Cofre-only and Focus+Read are diagnostic controls. The free-swap control has zero Focus cost; the Focus+Read control still samples an unused reserve lane but hides and disables Cofre, which is distributionally inert only under infinite-rank sampling with replacement.
Common random lanes provide reproducible offline coupling, not finite-shoe equivalence, live mirrored fairness, competitive skill evidence, or human playtest outcomes.
Confidence intervals are marginal normal intervals over paired Night score differences; profiles share scenarios, comparisons are correlated and no multiplicity adjustment is applied.

execution.timingNote: execution time is nondeterministic metadata; result reproduces byte-for-byte for the same options
